test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the only President of India to have her/his wax statue at the Madame Tussauds wax museum in Delhi as of September 2020?
solution: The correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam.**__ • **APJ Abdul Kalam** is the only President of India to have her/his wax statue at the Madame Tussauds wax museum in Delhi as of September 2020. • Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam was the 11th President of India who has also written the books like Wings of Fire, Ignited Minds, India 2020.
